SELECT count(*) AS n, count(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_id, count(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_rl, sum(net_amount) AS net,
 count(*) FILTER (WHERE staff_purchase_flag) AS staff, min(sale_date), max(sale_date), count(DISTINCT etl_loaded_at) AS loads

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.store_id, s.format, p.category, f.net_amount, f.quantity
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
), refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) AS qr FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT l.format, (l.store_id=999) AS is999, (l.category='ZZ Test') AS zz, count(*) AS n, sum(l.net_amount) AS sold, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) AS ret,
 count(r.sales_line_id) AS nret, count(DISTINCT l.store_id) AS stores,
 sum(CASE WHEN r.refund_net > l.net_amount + 0.005 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_refund
FROM sold l LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT w.status, count(*) AS n, sum(f.net_amount) AS sold, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) AS ret, count(r.sales_line_id) AS nret
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1) r ON r.sales_line_id=f.sales_line_id
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period=2 AND s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY ALL
SELECT store_id, count(DISTINCT format) AS nf, count(*) AS versions, min(format), max(format) FROM dim_store GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(DISTINCT format)>1 OR store_id>=900

calls.statement:
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sales_line_id, s.format, f.net_amount
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN dim_date d    ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
      AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period = 2
),
refunds AS (
    SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, l.format AS store_format,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(l.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold_lines l
LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (sales_line_id)
GROUP BY l.format
ORDER BY l.format
